title: ^FASHION FORECASTING AND MARKET ANALYSIS
description: Forecasting and market analysis processes applied to fashion goods.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: WR 222, 222H, 227Z, 227HZ, 323, 323H, 327 or 327H.
A minimum grade of C- is required in WR 222, WR 222H, WR 227Z, WR 227HZ, WR 323, WR 323H, WR 327 and WR 327H.

Students with a term class standing of Freshman or Sophomore may not enroll.

Enrollment is limited to students with a program in Merchandising Management (055), Apparel Design (400), Marketing (799) or Product and Merchandising Mgmt (A014).
